product_description: Over-ear noise cancelling wireless headphones with hard carrying case, 3.5mm audio cable, USB-C charging cable, and user manual.
scenario: Customer returned the wireless headphones and all accessories, but the headphones have severe physical damage (cracked headband / broken hinge mechanism).
controlled_change: Physical structural damage to headband/hinge on the returned headphones.
evidence_notes: Identity matches the WH-1001 model and all expected accessories (case, cables, manual) are present. However, IMG-02 shows distinct structural cracking/breakage on the headband and hinge assembly. Under rule 5c, an item in Used - Acceptable condition with observed_state 'damaged' is routed to dispose.
